item.title: Israeli forces enter several Lebanese villages
item.description: Israeli forces have advanced into a number of towns and villages in south Lebanon, a source from the U.N. peacekeeping force in the country, UNIFIL, told AFP on Wednesday.

item.title: Hezbollah says targeted the headquarters of Israel Aerospace Industries
item.description: Hezbollah said on Wednesday it had targeted the headquarters of Israel Aerospace Industries, in central Israel, overnight with a drone attack while also saying it launched a missile at a drone control base.

item.title: Israeli army tells residents south of Lebanon's Litani river to move north
item.description: The Israeli military told residents living south of Lebanon's Litani river to immediately head north on Wednesday, warning that the Israeli army was "compelled to take military action" against Hezbollah in the area.

item.title: Hezbollah says targeted military base near Tel Aviv with drone swarm
item.description: Hezbollah said Wednesday it had targeted an Israeli military base near Tel Aviv in central Israel and a naval base in Haifa in the north with swarms of attack drones.

item.title: Israel army says two soldiers injured by anti-tank fire in south Lebanon
item.description: The Israeli military said anti-tank fire in south Lebanon injured two of its soldiers on Wednesday, after Hezbollah said it had struck two Israeli military vehicles.

item.title: Iran threatens to target Israeli embassies worldwide if Israel targets its Lebanon mission
item.description: Iran's armed forces threatened on Wednesday to target Israeli missions worldwide if Israel were to attack Tehran's mission in Lebanon, a military spokesman said.

item.title: Lebanese Army arrests 27 for weapons possession as Hezbollah military activity banned
item.description: The Lebanese Army said Wednesday it had arrested 27 people in the past two days for "illegally possessing weapons and ammunition", following a government decision to ban Hezbollah's military activities.

item.title: Qassem says Hezbollah to confront Israel-US 'aggression', will not surrender
item.description: Hezbollah will confront "Israeli-American aggression" and will not surrender despite the "imbalance in capabilities", the head of the Iran-backed Lebanese group Sheikh Naim Qassem said Wednesday night in a televised speech.

item.title: Macron urges Netanyahu to avoid ground offensive in Lebanon
item.description: France's President Emmanuel Macron said he urged Israel's Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu on Wednesday to "refrain from a ground offensive" in Lebanon in their first phone call since last summer.

item.title: Three killed in two Israeli strikes near Beirut
item.description: Three people were killed in a pair of Israeli strikes on vehicles near Beirut, Lebanon's health ministry said late Wednesday, after a third day of Israeli bombardments in response to renewed Hezbollah attacks.
